articles.title: Giant Beetle Babies Are Eating Blueberry Roots
articles.summary: Scientists used DNA to name the giant beetle larvae eating blueberry roots in North Carolina: the longhorn beetle Prionus imbricornus.

articles.title: Send Your Name to Saturn's Moon Titan
articles.summary: NASA will carry your name to Saturn's moon Titan on Dragonfly, a flying robot that launches in 2028 and will hop across the moon looking for the chemistry of life.

articles.title: Europe's Ancient Forests Were Open and Sunny
articles.summary: Europe was not covered in dark, dense forest for millions of years — it was open woodland, meadows, and grazing animals, and that finding questions today's dense tree-planting programs.
